data.research_question: 提出AntiFold，一个基于ESM-IF1微调的抗体特异性逆折叠模型，旨在保持结构完整性的同时优化抗体序列设计。
data.why_hard: 现有逆折叠工具在互补决定区（CDR）的序列恢复能力有限，且ProteinMPNN类工具存在链重排或插入等不兼容抗体结构的问题。

evidence.research_question: Here, we present AntiFold, an antibody-specific inverse folding model, fine-tuned from ESM-IF1 on solved and predicted antibody structures.

data.abstract: Summary: The design and optimization of antibodies requires an intricate balance across multiple properties. Protein inverse folding models, capable of generating diverse sequences folding into the same structure, are promising tools for maintaining structural integrity during antibody design. Here, we present AntiFold, an antibody-specific inverse folding model, fine-tuned from ESM-IF1 on solved and predicted antibody structures. AntiFold outperforms existing inverse folding tools on sequence recovery across complementarity-determining regions, with designed sequences showing high structural similarity to their solved counterpart. It additionally achieves stronger correlations when predicting antibody-antigen binding affinity in a zero-shot manner, while performance is augmented further when including antigen information. AntiFold assigns low probabilities to mutations that disrupt antigen binding, synergizing with protein language model residue probabilities, and demonstrates promise for guiding antibody optimization while retaining structure-related properties.

algorithms.name: AntiFold
problems_solved: 现有抗体逆折叠工具在CDR区域序列恢复率低
ProteinMPNN基工具存在链重排或IMGT编号间隙等结构兼容性问题
需要在保持骨架结构不变的前提下优化抗体序列
algorithms.mechanism: 基于ESM-IF1预训练模型，在已解决和预测的抗体结构上进行微调，采用跨度掩码、随机残基掩码及CDR加权策略提升CDRH3恢复率。
algorithms.why_it_works: 利用ESM-IF1的大规模预训练数据基础，结合抗体特异性数据微调，显著提高了CDR区域的氨基酸恢复率和零样本亲和力预测相关性。
applicable_to: 抗体结构约束下的序列设计
维持骨架结构的抗体优化
limitations: 未直接与IgMPNN比较，因其模型权重和训练数据不可用
